2a86c94 hf3fs: evict least-recently-used pages under reader leases  A full page pool makes every save fail (issue #62389). #62393 stops cache hits and duplicate keys from consuming new pages, but nothing returns pages to the free list once the pool is exhausted.  Evicting a key a batch already decided to hit would turn a hit into a load failure or stale data, so the load path now takes a lease: acquire before reading, release once the blocks are in host buffers. The server only reclaims complete, unleased, non-hit keys, oldest first, and expired leases reclaim themselves so a crashed reader cannot pin pages forever.  Older metadata servers without the new routes fall back to a plain lookup (they never evict, so the lookup is still safe).  Assisted-by: DeepSeek Harness (AI coding agent) <noreply@deepseek.com>
